content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 17-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What are the posts available in IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IIT Delhi is recruiting for Project Scientist and Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.) positions. A total of 2 vacancies are available for these project-based roles.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting applications via email for the IIT Delhi Project Scientist and Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.) posts is 17 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for these IIT Delhi posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply for the IIT Delhi Project Scientist and Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.) positions by sending their applications via email.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Project Scientist at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The salary for a Project Scientist at IIT Delhi ranges from Rs. 47,790 to Rs. 62,350/- p.m. plus HRA @27%, depending on the pay scale.

faq.question: Q5. What are the qualifications required for Project Scientist?
faq.answer: For Project Scientist, candidates need a B.Tech/M.Sc/M.C.A/post Graduate in a relevant discipline with a 1st class or equivalent.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for IIT Delhi Project-based positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their qualifications and requirements, followed by an online interview for those shortlisted.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the Project Scientist and Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.) positions at IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be found on the IIT Delhi IRD website. A direct link to the PDF will be provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job location for these posts?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Scientist and Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.) positions is New Delhi, Delhi (Pincode: 110016) at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. How should I send my application via email?
faq.answer: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4, fill it completely, and email it with all required documents. Ensure the subject line includes the advertisement number and send it to [email protected] before the last date.
